proposal.hypothesis: Interleaving the two terminal-power recurrences may reduce loop and SIMD-dispatch overhead while preserving each direction's multiplication order and all payoff indices. Whether this improves the full call remains to be measured.

retained: Based on the valid measured G source, retaining its lane-contiguous batches, thread-budget-aware outer parallelism, double-precision powers, and hoisted rollback coefficients.
